issue.title: Background Image not scrollable

repository.name: streamlit
repository.description: Streamlit — A faster way to build and share data apps.

body:
I know the topic is closed, but maybe somebody can find my experience beneficial for their projects too. 

To make the bg_image scroll I changed the ".stAPP" selector to a ".main". I also changed background-attachment: scroll --> background-attachment: local.
That was super helpful @dianageorgieva2. Thanks for taking the time to help others even when the topic was closed.

Hi,

I am still not able to get the background image to my app.

I am using the below code :


```
def get_base64(bin_file):
    with open(bin_file, 'rb') as f:
        data = f.read()
    return base64.b64encode(data).decode()
```

```

def set_background(png_file):
    bin_str = get_base64(png_file)
    page_bg_img = '''
    <style>
    body {
    background-image: url("data:image/png;base64,%s");
    background-size: cover;
    }
    </style>
    ''' % bin_str
    st.markdown(page_bg_img, unsafe_allow_html=True)

set_background('streamlit_ui/img/website.jpg')
```

Below are my streamlit library's configuration :
Name: streamlit
Version: 1.31.1

Can you please tell me what is the issue here ?

@dianageorgieva2   

Thank you for your response. It worked !
